title: Whether accepting the priest's blessing (opening the barrow) would conflict with a later promise to the reeve (sealing it) wasn't fully clear until both NPCs and the innkeeper were consulted — the game rewards asking everyone, but a first-time player could easily lock in a contradiction without knowing to ask around first.
